Title: General availability: Support for SQL Server in data flows using Azure Data Factory & Azure Synapse

Body.Content:
Data Flows are a low-code visual data transformation tool that executes at scale with just-in-time Spark compute in Azure Data Factory and Azure Synapse. You can now connect to your on-premises and VM-based SQL Server natively within data flows.

Learn more.
